Customer Care & Guidance

Frequently asked questions.

Clear answers about our botanical apothecary collections, doctor consultation bookings, wholesale trade terms, and quality verification standards.

How does ordering and checkout work?

Your shopping bag is saved locally on your device. In our current release, customers can review quantities, compare botanical collections, and generate an assisted order invoice or checkout link with our care desk before payment is finalized.

Are VanaVeda products medical treatments?

No. Our teas, herbal oils, supplements, skincare, and hair care items are formulated for daily wellness rituals, topical nourishment, and constitutional balance. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.

How do doctor consultation booking requests work?

You can prepare your preferred consultation mode, date, time window, and focus area through the five-step request form. The frontend stores the result locally; a secure intake service and verified provider workflow must be connected before response timing or appointment confirmation can be promised.

How do you verify quality and third-party certifications?

VanaVeda maintains a strict policy of evidence before emblem. We verify third-party Certificates of Analysis (COAs), botanical test methods, and facility compliance standards. Visit our Certifications & Quality page to learn how to request specific batch records.

How do I choose the right Ayurvedic collection for my needs?

Explore our ingredient glossary to understand the traditional energetics of individual plants (such as Tulsi, Amla, or Bhringraj), or book a doctor consultation for a personalized constitutional assessment of your Vata, Pitta, and Kapha balance.

Do you offer trade wholesale partnerships for boutiques and spas?

Yes. We partner with curated boutiques, luxury wellness spas, yoga shalas, and organic grocers. Visit our Contact page and toggle to the dedicated Wholesale Enquiry form to apply.

Where is the physical store and dispensary located?

Our partner dispensary counters and clinical consultation rooms are currently accessible by appointment. Official flagship retail coordinates will be announced following verified regional licensing audits.
